results.fact: NWAC forecast-zone coverage: Reports tab (climate) vs. Safety tab (avalanche)
results.evidence: NWAC's own published forecast-zone polygons (served through the national avalanche.org map layer) place Dumbell's summit, the Phelps Creek trailhead, Lyman Lake and Holden all well inside the East Slopes Central zone, so the Safety tab's claim that no named NWAC zone covers the peak is false. The row's climate.forecastZone already names this zone. Only one external source was found (the forecaster's own boundary data, which is definitive for its own zones); no independent second page describing zone extents could be retrieved, so treat this as one authoritative source plus the row.

results.correct_value: Frenchman Coulee access: I-90 exit 143, Silica Road SW, Vantage Road SW to the climbers' lot; Discover Pass; short walk to a north-facing, all-day-shade wall; Vantage Road SW closed since a May 2026 rockslide
results.evidence: True Grit is a 5.10c sport route on Postal Wall at Frenchman Coulee. The crag's access page and a trail page both give I-90 exit 143, left on Silica Road under the freeway, then left on Vantage Road SW, and both require a Discover Pass (WDFW-managed land); a regional guide confirms Postal Wall is reached from the main climbers' lot below the Middle East Wall and lists it among the shaded walls, and the Middle East Wall page says it faces north and is always in shade. Two news reports and the crag page state Vantage Road SW west of Silica Road has been closed indefinitely since a May 17, 2026 rockslide. The Mountain Loop/Sunrise Mine Road corridor, Northwest Forest Pass and 3-hour approach were copied from an unrelated alpine route; the true approach (about 15 min / 0.5 mi) rests on one source only, so approachTimeHrs and dist_km are cleared rather than replaced. Unflagged, not patched: rock_grade '5.8' disagrees with grade '5.10c' (the header pill shows 5.8); one source gives 5.10c.
